units.source_text: 白108具有威胁左上角黑棋和侵削中央黑厚势的两层意义，并兼守左边白空，这是绝妙的一手。

en.t: White 108 has the double significance of threatening Black's stones in the upper left corner and reducing Black's thick central influence, while also defending White's territory on the left side. It is a brilliant move.
